messages:
Priya Nair: hello! first week here — I completed the onboarding flow but a couple Grafana panels show 'No data' and Datadog traces are missing spans. who should I ping? :wave:
Tom B: hey priya, welcome! quick checks: 1) are you in the grafana SSO group (infra-read)? 2) Datadog service filters sometimes default to personal scope.
Priya Nair: checked groups via idp web UI — I see org:eng but not infra-read.
obs-bot: Observability onboarding tip: Grafana dashboards require SSO group `infra-read` or `platform-view`. Datadog dashboard shares are granted via `dd-basic-read`. Sentry projects require per-project invites. Docs: https://docs.redwood.com/devex/observability/onboarding
Tom B: @infra-andy can you run the idp assign for priya? `idp assign-group priya.nair@redwood.com infra-read`
infra-andy: running it now... assigned infra-read and queued dd-basic-read grant. Give it ~30s to propagate. Also removed an old personal filter from a shared dashboard that caused 'No data' for some newcomers.
Priya Nair: refreshing — Grafana panels are populating! Datadog traces still show only my service, not others.
Tom B: Datadog: check the 'Service' dropdown at top left of the trace view. If it's set to priya-service try 'All services'. If sharing isn't working, DM ops-grants with team=infra-tooling and reason=onboarding.
Priya Nair: changed to All services — looks good now. One more: where do I find the oncall runbooks linked from dashboards?
infra-andy: Runbooks are linked in dashboard notes and centrally at https://docs.redwood.com/devex/observability/runbooks. If you want quick links: grafana -> dashboard header -> 'Runbook' link.
Priya Nair: perfect, thank you! tagging this for future newbies. :white_check_mark:
